svg.text: Backup request or selected restore file
Rectangle = external entity | Numbered box = process | D1-D6 = logical data stores | Arrow = data flow
Paolo Paolo D.A. Matting and Accessories Inventory and Sales System
Repeated rectangles refer to the same entity/store. Customer and Labor have no login role in the supplied use case.
*Labor and D3 service flows are retained from the previous Level 0; they are not covered by the supplied use case.
D6 is the aggregate of D1-D4 for backup/restore, not an additional physical database.
